statement: The distributed runner loads each Scenario A visibility module and consumes its admission preflight before constructing or starting a cluster, refusing uncertified runs without resource allocation, while ordinary scenarios retain their behavior; the visibility scenario revalidates the same admission identity at execution and never treats a preflight token as semantic proof. The existing runner and admission owner are the sole paths, witnessed by a red-on-revert unit test and static call-order metric. No live testing, new workflow, or new script is authorized by this Quest.

constraints.statement: An absent, malformed, non-visibility-bound or source-mismatched admission must fail before clusterFactory or cluster.start; a deterministic test must fail on the old ordering.
No live formation certification is inferred, and every regular scenario without a preStart owner retains its previous execution semantics.
A separate verifier attacks admission/gating and harness fidelity before landing.
